focal.name: Sawen-Geet
focal.who: A lizardman archer from the southern marshes who never gambles and never explains why.
focal.backstory: Sawen-Geet pawned her mother's egg-stone, the one thing her clan trusted her with, to buy passage north. She has been saving to buy it back ever since.
